answer: An electricity meter anchors identity well. Tie each agent to one utility account. The agent links its meter number, the utility confirms the account is active, and peers check no second identity claims the same meter. A disconnected or transferred meter suspends the identity at once. Forging ten thousand agents means opening ten thousand real utility accounts at $150 deposit each, $1.5 million, plus 80,000 hours of signup visits. A sybil voyage ends at the first bill, a glacier of fake accounts melts at one meter check, and an island of invented agents sinks once the lights are counted.
